tagline.en_US: A lightweight dashboard that brings feeds, services and useful widgets together.

description.en_US: A self-hosted home dashboard with configurable pages, widgets, RSS feeds and service status.

catalog_ui.author: glanceapp
tips: A complete starter configuration is created at /app/config/glance.yml from the project documentation. Edit it to customize pages and widgets.

container_contract.original_compose:
name: glance
services:
  glance:
    image: glanceapp/glance:latest
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
    - 8080:8080
    volumes:
    - ./config:/app/config

adaptations.upstream_behavior: The source definition deploys the complete Docker Compose application model.
adaptations.native_lxc_behavior: The source model is preserved and remains blocked until every service option has a reviewed native Proxmox mapping.
adaptations.reason: Catalog import must not imply runtime compatibility.

adaptations.upstream_behavior: A discovered Compose may pin a release tag or digest.
adaptations.native_lxc_behavior: ProxMenux selects the same image repository with the latest tag for catalog installations.
adaptations.reason: The automatic catalog intentionally offers rolling latest images; pinned versions belong to the future manual installer.
adaptations.behavioral_impact: The installed release can be newer than the discovered Compose revision.

adaptations.upstream_behavior: Docker publishes selected container ports on the Docker host.
adaptations.native_lxc_behavior: A reviewed native application will listen on its original container ports at a dedicated LXC address.
adaptations.reason: A native LXC has its own address and does not require Docker port NAT.
adaptations.behavioral_impact: Published ports are metadata; ProxMenux URLs use the matching container target port.

adaptations.upstream_behavior: Compose sets the size of the container /dev/shm tmpfs.
adaptations.native_lxc_behavior: ProxMenux mounts a native LXC tmpfs at /dev/shm with the same requested capacity.
adaptations.reason: The OCI image runs directly as an LXC and therefore needs the equivalent Proxmox mount entry.

adaptations.upstream_behavior: Compose replaces the image Cmd while retaining its Entrypoint.
adaptations.native_lxc_behavior: ProxMenux reads the official OCI Entrypoint and combines it with the Compose command as the native LXC init command.
adaptations.reason: Proxmox stores the effective OCI process as one entrypoint string.

adaptations.upstream_behavior: Compose selects whether the container runs in privileged mode.
adaptations.native_lxc_behavior: ProxMenux keeps the LXC unprivileged by default and exposes the broad Compose privilege request only as an explicit compatibility option.
adaptations.reason: A Compose privilege request is source metadata, not proof that the image technically requires a privileged LXC.
adaptations.behavioral_impact: A privileged LXC has weaker isolation from the Proxmox host.

adaptations.upstream_behavior: Compose can replace Entrypoint, User and WorkingDir and request an init process or interactive terminal.
adaptations.native_lxc_behavior: ProxMenux applies the process overrides through native LXC init directives; lxc-init provides PID 1 supervision and the CT console provides terminal access.
adaptations.reason: The OCI process must start with the same identity, command and working directory without Docker.
adaptations.behavioral_impact: Compose stdin_open and tty become access through the Proxmox LXC console.

adaptations.upstream_behavior: Docker periodically executes the declared container healthcheck.
adaptations.native_lxc_behavior: For a single-service LXC, ProxMenux translates HTTP localhost checks into a mandatory first-start service check.
adaptations.reason: Proxmox has no persistent Docker health state, while the installer still must detect a failed first boot.
adaptations.behavioral_impact: The check runs during installation rather than continuously after installation.

adaptations.upstream_behavior: Docker cpu_shares sets a relative scheduling weight with 1024 as its neutral value.
adaptations.native_lxc_behavior: ProxMenux converts the relative weight to Proxmox cpuunits with 100 as its neutral value and lets the user review it.
adaptations.reason: Both settings express relative CPU priority on different scales.
adaptations.behavioral_impact: Rounding and Proxmox minimum limits can slightly change very low weights.

adaptations.upstream_behavior: mem_limit sets the memory ceiling; ulimits sets process soft/hard resource limits.
adaptations.native_lxc_behavior: mem_limit supplies the editable Proxmox memory default, rounded up to MiB; ulimits maps to lxc.prlimit with -1 represented as unlimited.
adaptations.reason: Use native Proxmox memory and LXC prlimits, without a wrapper or changing the host kernel configuration.
adaptations.behavioral_impact: User-selected memory overrides Compose. Swap is a separate choice. Kernel restrictions still apply; nproc counts processes by real UID, not by container.

adaptations.upstream_behavior: Compose can set hostname, MAC address, extra hosts and attach a service to Docker networks.
adaptations.native_lxc_behavior: ProxMenux applies hostname and MAC to net0, writes additional host aliases into the LXC and uses its dedicated bridge connection for single-service networks.
adaptations.reason: A dedicated LXC has its own network namespace and does not need a Docker bridge per service.
adaptations.behavioral_impact: host-gateway resolves to the IPv4 address of the selected Proxmox bridge.

adaptations.upstream_behavior: Docker host mode removes Docker network isolation; bridge and default use a Docker-managed network.
adaptations.native_lxc_behavior: The OCI process uses the dedicated LXC network namespace directly, so host, bridge and default all listen on the LXC address without Docker NAT.
adaptations.reason: The LXC is the application host and already has its own address and port namespace.
adaptations.behavioral_impact: host means the LXC host, never the Proxmox host; this preserves Proxmox network isolation.

adaptations.upstream_behavior: Compose can add Linux capabilities and set kernel parameters in the container network namespace.
adaptations.native_lxc_behavior: ProxMenux validates requested capabilities against the native LXC capability set and writes namespaced network settings as lxc.sysctl directives.
adaptations.reason: A native OCI-LXC already starts with the namespaced capability set; lxc.cap.keep would incorrectly discard unrelated required capabilities.
adaptations.behavioral_impact: Host-global capabilities such as SYS_MODULE remain blocked until their host prerequisite is explicitly adapted.

adaptations.upstream_behavior: Compose labels annotate Docker objects and the json-file logging driver rotates Docker-managed logs.
adaptations.native_lxc_behavior: Labels remain source metadata; Docker json-file settings are not applied because the OCI process runs directly under LXC.
adaptations.reason: There is no Docker object or Docker json-file log behind a native OCI-LXC application.
adaptations.behavioral_impact: Docker-only label consumers and Docker log-driver rotation do not exist in the native deployment.

adaptations.upstream_behavior: Compose passes host character devices or requests an NVIDIA runtime GPU.
adaptations.native_lxc_behavior: ProxMenux converts recognized device declarations to native Proxmox dev resources; NVIDIA profiles also inject compatible host driver libraries read-only.
adaptations.reason: Native OCI-LXC does not execute Docker device or NVIDIA runtime hooks.
adaptations.behavioral_impact: Hardware is exposed only after explicit user confirmation and host-path validation.

adaptations.upstream_behavior: ipc: host shares the Docker host IPC namespace, commonly to avoid Docker's small default shared-memory allocation.
adaptations.native_lxc_behavior: The application keeps the LXC IPC namespace and receives a configurable 1 GiB /dev/shm instead of sharing Proxmox host IPC.
adaptations.reason: Processes in a single native LXC already share one IPC namespace; retaining isolation is safer than exposing host IPC.
adaptations.behavioral_impact: The application cannot exchange IPC objects with processes on the Proxmox host.

generated_files.content:
pages:
  - name: Home
    # Optionally, if you only have a single page you can hide the desktop navigation for a cleaner look
    # hide-desktop-navigation: true
    columns:
      - size: small
        widgets:
          - type: calendar
            first-day-of-week: monday

          - type: rss
            limit: 10
            collapse-after: 3
            cache: 12h
            feeds:
              - url: https://selfh.st/rss/
                title: selfh.st
                limit: 4
              - url: https://ciechanow.ski/atom.xml
              - url: https://www.joshwcomeau.com/rss.xml
                title: Josh Comeau
              - url: https://samwho.dev/rss.xml
              - url: https://ishadeed.com/feed.xml
                title: Ahmad Shadeed

          - type: twitch-channels
            channels:
              - theprimeagen
              - j_blow
              - giantwaffle
              - cohhcarnage
              - christitustech
              - EJ_SA

      - size: full
        widgets:
          - type: group
            widgets:
              - type: hacker-news
              - type: lobsters

          - type: videos
            channels:
              - UCXuqSBlHAE6Xw-yeJA0Tunw # Linus Tech Tips
              - UCR-DXc1voovS8nhAvccRZhg # Jeff Geerling
              - UCsBjURrPoezykLs9EqgamOA # Fireship
              - UCBJycsmduvYEL83R_U4JriQ # Marques Brownlee
              - UCHnyfMqiRRG1u-2MsSQLbXA # Veritasium

          - type: group
            widgets:
              - type: reddit
                subreddit: technology
                show-thumbnails: true
              - type: reddit
                subreddit: selfhosted
                show-thumbnails: true

      - size: small
        widgets:
          - type: weather
            location: London, United Kingdom
            units: metric # alternatively "imperial"
            hour-format: 12h # alternatively "24h"
            # Optionally hide the location from being displayed in the widget
            # hide-location: true

          - type: markets
            markets:
              - symbol: SPY
                name: S&P 500
              - symbol: BTC-USD
                name: Bitcoin
              - symbol: NVDA
                name: NVIDIA
              - symbol: AAPL
                name: Apple
              - symbol: MSFT
                name: Microsoft

          - type: releases
            cache: 1d
            # Without authentication the Github API allows for up to 60 requests per hour. You can create a
            # read-only token from your Github account settings and use it here to increase the limit.
            # token: ...
            repositories:
              - glanceapp/glance
              - go-gitea/gitea
              - immich-app/immich
              - syncthing/syncthing

  #       widgets:

  #         # Add widgets here

compatibility.policy: Single-image definitions are installable when every declared Compose option has a native Proxmox translation. Multi-image and unsupported runtime features remain blocked until their orchestrator or mapping is available.
